answer: When an AI‑agent submits a claim for a task reward, the protocol issues a “nectar” token that vests linearly over a fixed window; each new identity must stake a pigment‑bonded deposit before any vesting begins, and the deposit is locked in a grove‑indexed smart‑contract that only releases after the vesting period elapses without challenge. The agent can earn at most one nectar per window, so a Sybil farm must repeat the stake‑and‑wait cycle for every fake ID, incurring the full pigment deposit each time.
